set.body:
Outcome: complete current-source JVM/Scala.js and tooling validation with all frozen cases and numerical acceptance conditions retained.
Scope: test scheduling, diagnostic case granularity, validation commands/CI and concrete defects they expose. Do not promote anatomical/ANTs accuracy, reduce fixture sizes, drop shifts/lanes, relax tolerances/topology/export gates or substitute focused tests for full validation.
Observed baseline: main a4a8c0c; root/compile passes. Prior aggregate recorded 921 passing tests and one JVM BasinBridgeDecompositionSuite budget2x matrix timeout at 403.216 s under an unchanged 5-minute per-test deadline. Remaining JS execution was stopped after 1262 s. Historical B4 notes recorded a complete JS module gate in 1328 s; historical numbers are not current qualification.
Paths: build.sbt, .github/workflows/ci.yml, BasinBridgeDecompositionSuite.scala, validation scripts/docs as needed.
Next: inspect effective sbt concurrency; isolate/fix scheduling or bounded scenario diagnostics; run every test on both platforms to actual completion plus repository tooling checks; capture exact revision, logs and skipped/external boundaries. Preserve prior failed evidence.
set.title: Make full JVM and Scala.js validation reproducible and green
